guesses.breed: American Pit Bull Terrier / American Staffordshire Terrier
guesses.reason: Broad blocky head, wide-set muscular cheeks, short smooth fawn-and-white coat, and stocky compact build are classic bully-breed traits.
The fawn coat with white blaze and chest, slightly shorter muzzle, and loose lips hint at some Boxer influence.

guesses.breed: German Shepherd or other prick-eared breed
guesses.reason: The very large, tall, naturally upright ears are unusual for pit bull types and suggest a prick-eared breed somewhere in the mix.

breed.appearance: Tiki is a compact, muscular medium dog with a short, glossy fawn (light tan) coat, a bright white blaze running from forehead down the muzzle, and a broad white chest and white-tipped paws. Her oversized, upright bat-like ears are pink inside, her eyes are warm amber-brown with soft gray shading around them, and her black nose sits above a grayish muzzle with pink freckle patches on the upper lips. She has a broad, blocky head with full cheeks and wears a pink collar with a bone-shaped tag.
breed.fun_fact: Pit bull-type dogs are famous for their goofy, people-loving personalities and are champion couch cuddlers!
